target: High Signal Podcasts public landing and evidence-ledger entry

contract.purpose: Help people search useful podcast ideas, people, recurring books and tools, and inspect every result against its verbatim transcript excerpt and original source.
contract.purposeSource: site-health purposeContract for on-record plus repository PRODUCT.md and DESIGN.md
contract.canonicalPurpose: High Signal Podcasts helps people who want useful ideas from important podcasts find evidenced claims, recommendations, books, and tools without listening end to end by preserving attributable excerpts and source trails.
contract.audience: Founders, investors, journalists, operators, and other evidence-conscious podcast researchers.
contract.job: Move directly between claim search, people, recurring books and tools, and source episodes without the navigation competing with the evidence.
contract.thesis: The shared header should read like an editorial masthead: one quiet line, product-specific route names, and an exact active ledger mark instead of a generic tab strip.
contract.system: Preserve the warm paper, serif wordmark, compact sans metadata, one-pixel rules, evidence-rust action color, archival-green status, square geometry, and 44px interaction floor.
contract.signature: Desktop uses a single evidence-ledger masthead with a rust active rule; compact widths transform it into a native Browse disclosure with plain-language route descriptions.
contract.risk: Hiding desktop links behind a compact menu would slow research, while compressing every link onto mobile would recreate the rejected clutter; the breakpoint deliberately changes the navigation model.

projectCheck.command: pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck && pnpm --dir apps/web build

findings: The deterministic detector returned no findings. Independent landing review found no P0 or P1 issue across purpose, hierarchy, active navigation, evidence semantics, responsive layout, or the shared Ask AI and project-strip footer.

The production-mode homepage now uses a dated, verified corpus snapshot instead of blocking first paint on the slow aggregate stats query. Live claims, people, recommendation groups, and source episodes remain API-backed.

answers.product: A research archive of useful podcast claims, people, books, apps, tools, and source episodes.
answers.audience: Founders, investors, journalists, operators, and researchers who need attributable podcast evidence.
answers.value: It finds the useful line without requiring the full episode and keeps the transcript excerpt and original source inspectable.
answers.mechanism: Search and browsable indexes lead to claim cards and receipts containing speaker, quote, date, episode, publisher, and source.
answers.proof: The first view shows a real published claim receipt and explicitly dated verified-corpus counts.
answers.nextAction: Open Search claims, People, Books and tools, or Episodes; the wordmark returns home.

ownerFeedback.note: The owner explicitly rejected the previous navbar and delegated a focused local replacement. The new masthead removes the two-row pill navigation and duplicate actions; production release remains a separate approval boundary.
